newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank cuts refinancing offer, minimum rate.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank cuts refinancing offer, minimum rate.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had slashed one-week refinancing funds on offer by 100 billion lei to 500 billion lei and cut the minimum permitted rate to 220 percent from 226 percent last week.
Traders said the BNR move might trigger a slight oversubscription by banks, but the money market remained fairly liquid with overnight funds at some 217 percent and one-week prices near 225 percent.
Money market prices were expected to ease towards 210 percent after the fall in the minimum permitted rate.
